subject: Important Update: Changes to Your Subscription Plan
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you about some changes to our subscription plans that will be effective starting next month. Due to increasing costs, we have had to adjust our pricing slightly. We appreciate your continued support and understanding during this transition. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for being a part of our community. Best regards, The Subscription Service Team
